youtube_title: ₹5K to ₹50K on Expiry Day? The Real Math 🎰 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Buying cheap options on expiry day to turn ₹5,000 into ₹50,000? Here's why it usually goes to ₹0.

An option's time value melts every day, and on expiry day it hits zero by the close. So the price must move big, fast and today. SEBI's FY26 study: 59% of index-option turnover happened on expiry day itself; 88% of individual F&O traders lost money; 89% of traders under 30 lost money.

Rule: no lottery bets on expiry. Learn first, go small, only money you can afford to lose.
Moral: Expiry day is not a lottery ticket.

Source: SEBI study on F&O traders, FY26 (reported Aug 2026).
Education only, not investment advice.
